current_answer: OpenAI plugins are installable packages of reusable task instructions, tool connections or both. The universal directory distributes them for supported hosts; it does not grant universal execution, provider access or customer value. Choose the smallest useful architecture and actual channel, then inspect the boundary that blocks your next task. Publication is separate from approval, enhanced main-page placement and intended-recipient install/selection/use; exact results remain unobserved here.

catalogue_card.question: What is OpenAI’s new plugin marketplace, what can people use today, and how can developers build and publish useful plugins?
catalogue_card.text: Developer-first task guide: choose/build/test the useful component; locate OAuth configuration, decide a pending review, diagnose CLI capability or preserve teammate continuity. Missing directory tile? Check Publish and the exact publication-name/portal-link route without dismissing real failures. Documentation, offline evidence and actual use stay separate.

The 19 October HTTP 429/503 worked choice at /p/openai-plugin-marketplace/choose-architecture/#http-status-choice separates reference information, a proposed reusable skill procedure and a named static MCP contract. A controlled callable interface can justify MCP without live knowledge; public operation is an additional requirement. Pending review — 11 October, /p/openai-plugin-marketplace/submit-and-review/#pending-review: one active review per plugin; local fixes do not replace submitted materials. Conditional leave-valid/wait/cancel/replacement default is ours. Keep same-version draft versus complete new-ZIP wording scoped; every resubmission starts fresh review, no queue/SLA/priority/expedition/approval promise. Supported remote-MCP path retains current published version during review then directly publishes approved replacement, not remove-first or universal observed continuity. Package cancellation/unpublication and rejected-package/held-tool appeals differ; tool appeal pauses automatic MCP updates. Held definitions do not freeze backend code.

Conditional application secret belongs in server Connect, never file/ZIP/chat/log. Advanced settings display source; edit/upload/inspect does not prove saved registration unlocked/replaced. Optional reference method versus required declaration, real provider method, omitted default, private_key_jwt signing setup and API-key/header portal limits remain scoped in that route; no auth downgrade/reset bypass.

New session prerequisite is not universal cure; /clear stays same session, initial list is not picker limit, disabled implicit still permits explicit invocation. Unsupported version/error and local/workspace ownership matter; no trust/cache/standalone-control or cross-host workaround.

Optional/local support is not eligibility; meaningful separate public scope unimplemented, removal no remaining-gates pass. Conversion guidance conflict unresolved. Cloud/synced/local scope and native-binary/review limits remain in route; intended stop is not enforcement.

Actions/commerce — 4/3 October, /p/openai-plugin-marketplace/security-and-permissions/ and /p/openai-plugin-marketplace/business-models/: separate bounded private read/unsaved preview/send with truthful conditional hints. Metadata/chat/model confirmation/account/write scope is not consent; omit send without enforceable actual human fixed-action boundary, stop unknown-outcome redispatch. The protocol is hypothetical and untested. Serve existing entitled SaaS work without in-plugin digital sales/upsells or directing users to those transactions off-host; neutral denial not plan/transaction promotion. Six proposed cases and information-link audits have not been tested; physical-goods checkout tension gives no digital exception/enabling. Meeting Evidence 0.1.0 is a teaching example; finite checker 33 and recorder 49 are separate offline engineering assertions, not full-schema/safety/host/product success.
